classification: Unmodified pinned upstream date with original cwd and clock-setting rejection adapter
changes: No edits to upstream parsing, formatting, timezone resolution, file timestamps or clock reads.
The date crate disables optional non-English date localization, consistent with the family English-only catalog policy.
Original entry initializes WASI cwd from PWD using the existing family helper.
Original entry rejects the parsed upstream set option before execution on every target, including native test builds. No host clock is changed.
GNU date is a test oracle only, never a runtime fallback. Diagnostics, help and version remain uutils.
